items.title: Claude for small business: What it is and how to use it
items.summary: My friend runs a small dog boarding and training business. It's not a casual side hustle, either. She has a waitlist, a roster of regulars, and the kind of five-star reviews that take years to earn. She also has a full-time job.
items.whyItMatters: Written for your side of the market rather than for enterprise buyers. Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Practical walkthrough — read it once and decide, rather than bookmarking it.

items.title: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns
items.summary: Early testers are raving about what Instinct can do, but some say the AI assistant’s sweeping access, broad terms and ability to act on users’ behalf come with uncomfortable trade-offs.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Check what customer data you are currently passing to AI tools, and under what terms.
